findings.body: The script uses a robust JSON parser to check for 'SKIPPED' status and non-empty 'skip_reason', correctly differentiating between audited proofs and quarantine proofs.
findings.title: Correctly identifies SKIPPED quarantine proof

findings.body: Properly detects and fails if a package contains both quarantine SKIPPED proofs and standard audited PASS proofs in the same PR delta.
findings.title: Enforces exclusive SKIPPED mode

findings.body: Exempts quarantine mode from requiring an 'audited_head', while still ensuring that 'content_head' and 'proof_head' are bound.
findings.title: Properly adjusts required heads for quarantine mode

findings.body: Correctly triggers an error if an audit-pass signature is found alongside a SKIPPED proof package.
findings.title: Forbids PROOF.json.sig in quarantine mode

fixes_applied: Added _is_quarantine_skipped_proof helper to identify quarantine packages based on JSON shape.
Updated validate_proof_only_closure to branch logic based on quarantine_mode.
Modified validation to relax audited_head requirement and enforce signature absence in quarantine mode.
Added comprehensive unit tests covering missing signatures, missing heads, and forbidden signatures in quarantine mode.
remaining_risks: Minor risk of PROOF.json.sig being incorrectly handled if it's introduced as a directory rather than a file, though highly unlikely.
summary: The changes made by Grok correctly implement the quarantine SKIPPED mode logic for proof-only change-contracts. It gracefully handles the distinction between audited proof packages (requiring signatures and audited_head) and quarantine skipped packages (forbidding signatures and only requiring content_head and proof_head). Mixed mode is properly blocked. The tests comprehensively cover these new requirements, and no unintended scope or secrets are introduced.
